title: Monotonicity of the guarded configuration bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $\mathrm{mode}$ be one of the four codec modes, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $a$ be a 21-register configuration satisfying the guard: its control state meets the precondition for the codec program in mode $\mathrm{mode}$ on input $y$, and every register is at most $(8W(N)+8)(|y|+1)$. Then the precondition still holds and every register is at most $(8W(N)+8)(|y|+1)^1$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
The codec precondition holds for $a$ on $y$
Every register of $a$ is at most $(8W(N)+8)(|y|+1)$
